sloka: आश्वासयन्ती विविधैश्च वाक्यै ।र्वाक्योपचारे कुशलानाद्या ।रामस्य ताम् मातरमेवमुक्त्वा ।देवी सुमित्राविरराम रामा ॥२-४४-३०॥
transliteration: āśvāsayantī vividhaiśca vākyai ।rvākyopacāre kuśalānādyā ।rāmasya tām mātaramevamuktvā ।devī sumitrāvirarāma rāmā ॥2-44-30॥

translations.english: Irreproachable and skilful in the use of words, queen Sumitra of cheerful disposition fell silent after thus consoling Rama's mother in various ways.
